title: Fee Reminder Agent (Voice + WhatsApp)
summary: Remind parents of upcoming and overdue fee instalments on WhatsApp and by voice in their language, share a UPI link, confirm payments and route hardship requests to the accounts office.

seo.title: Fee Reminder Agent on WhatsApp and Voice | VipraTech
seo.description: Polite fee instalment reminders for schools and coaching institutes on WhatsApp and voice, with UPI links, payment checks and escalation to accounts.

problem.intro: Schools collect fees monthly or quarterly, and coaching institutes split a programme fee into instalments tied to dates or phases. The accounts office ends up sending manual WhatsApp messages and making awkward calls, while some parents have already paid through another channel and others need an extension they hesitate to ask for.

pain_points.title: Manual chasing
pain_points.detail: Accounts staff export due lists from the ERP and message or call parents one by one, every cycle.

pain_points.title: Paid but still reminded
pain_points.detail: Payments by UPI, bank transfer or at the counter take time to reconcile, so parents who have paid still get reminders and complain.

pain_points.title: Tone problems
pain_points.detail: Reminders that sound like recovery calls damage the relationship, and messages that reach the student instead of the parent cause distress.

pain_points.title: Hardship goes unspoken
pain_points.detail: Families facing a genuine problem rarely call the office, so a late payment turns into a dropout without anyone offering a plan.

solution.overview: We build a reminder agent that reads due and overdue instalments from your ERP and contacts the parent or guardian, not the student. WhatsApp comes first, with an approved template, the amount, due date and a UPI payment link. If the instalment stays unpaid, a short, polite voice call follows in Hindi, English or the family's preferred language. Parents can say they have already paid, ask for a receipt, request more time or ask to speak to accounts. Payments are confirmed against the gateway before any further reminder, and requests for extensions or concessions go to the accounts office, which decides.
capabilities: Due-list sync from the ERP with instalment, concession and sibling details
WhatsApp reminders with approved templates and UPI payment links or QR codes
Polite voice calls in Hindi, English and regional languages for unpaid instalments
Payment confirmation against the gateway before any follow-up
Captures already-paid claims, receipt requests and extension requests for accounts
Calling windows, frequency caps and opt-outs enforced for each family

workflow.title: Sync the due list
workflow.detail: Upcoming, due and overdue instalments are pulled from the ERP each morning, with guardian contact details.

workflow.title: Send a WhatsApp reminder
workflow.detail: The guardian receives an approved template with the amount, due date and a UPI link or QR code.

workflow.title: Check payment status
workflow.detail: Gateway and bank feeds are checked so paid instalments drop out before the next step.

workflow.title: Voice follow-up
workflow.detail: Instalments still unpaid at the agreed point get a short, polite call in the guardian's language.

workflow.title: Handle responses
workflow.detail: Claims of payment, receipt requests and extension requests are captured and routed to the accounts office.

workflow.title: Confirm and update
workflow.detail: Receipts are sent on WhatsApp and the ERP is updated with payments and promised dates.

inputs: Instalment schedule and due list from the ERP
Guardian names, numbers and preferred language
Payment gateway and bank transaction feeds
Approved WhatsApp templates and call scripts
Concession, scholarship and sibling discount records
outputs: Call outcomes with promised payment dates
Extension and dispute requests for accounts
Updated payment status in the ERP
Collection status report by class, batch or centre
human_in_the_loop: The accounts office decides every extension, concession, waiver and disputed payment. The agent never threatens consequences for the student, such as withholding results or admit cards; any such policy is communicated only by the school or institute itself.
integrations: Accounting software such as Tally or Zoho Books
guardrails: Contacts guardians only, never the student, for minors
Payment status checked immediately before every message or call
Calling windows, frequency caps and opt-outs enforced automatically
No threatening, shaming or coercive language; scripts approved by management
Hardship cues routed to a person rather than repeated reminders
compliance_notes: Voice and SMS reminders must follow TRAI commercial communication rules, including registered templates and customer preferences.
Guardian and student details are personal data under the DPDP Act 2023; designed to support purpose limitation and retention limits.

pilot.scope: One fee cycle for selected classes or batches, with reminders sent by the agent and accounts handling every escalation.
deliverables: Reminder schedule and templates approved by management
WhatsApp and voice flows connected to your ERP and gateway
Pilot report on outcomes and parent feedback
Roll-out plan and messaging cost estimate

what_we_measure.how: Instalments paid by the due date and within the cycle, compared with a similar previous cycle.
Reminders sent to guardians who had already paid, from complaints and reconciliation.
Extension, dispute and receipt requests captured, and time to an accounts decision.
Opt-outs, complaints and a short feedback question after payment.

faqs.a: No. For minors it contacts only the registered guardian numbers, and student numbers are excluded from the contact list.

faqs.q: How do you avoid reminding parents who have paid?
faqs.a: The agent checks the payment gateway and bank feed immediately before every message or call. Counter payments need to be entered in the ERP, and the pilot measures any reminders that still reach paid families.
It captures the request and the reason, but only your accounts office approves extensions or concessions. The parent is told when to expect a decision.
Hindi and English by default, with regional languages added for your parent base. WhatsApp templates are approved per language.
